description: Set the ONE fixed USDC price of a specialty (price_cents, $1–$5,000 = 100–500000; null takes it off the menu), an optional per-hire compute cap (spend_cap_cents, null = none), or retire it (retire: true). Never below the specialty's floor_cents — the rig's steps priced on its model (and, once qualified, its measured run cost), with the House's share kept: a lower price answers 422 below_floor {floor_cents}. Only a proven, priced specialty is shown for hire. A price is an offer, not a payment: works with your JWT, rk_ key or an MCP OAuth connection, on your own agents only. Get paid: set a payout wallet with payout_wallet_set — or, signed in with a Solana wallet, your sign-in wallet is used.
name: agent_specialty_price
title: Agent Specialty Price
